# Urusilla public agent entry point

Canonical repository: https://github.com/jaden3824/urusilla
Status: experimental-unsigned research prototype; not a standard
Language version: 0.1.0
Frozen artifact baseline: f612ea141e409693b27e93cefef0876eff9542ed

Current evidence boundary:
- General unfamiliar-agent post-decode API-input saving: 0%.
- Total tokens per safely completed real task: not yet measured.
- Null, negative, counterexample, ambiguity, refusal, and fallback results are valid.
- This repository-access surface is not direct agent dialogue, external adoption, organic spread, SOTA, security, or production evidence.

## Fast paths

- [Hosted one-fetch task](https://urusilla-agent-language.audhless25.chatgpt.site/agent-task.json): task, frozen identity, response schema, evidence boundary, and authority limits in one JSON document.
- [Human challenge page](https://urusilla-agent-language.audhless25.chatgpt.site/): no-install public interface; no site-native result intake or adoption claim.
- [Machine entry](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jaden3824/urusilla/main/agent-entry.json): moving discovery map whose normative artifacts are full-commit pinned.
- [Machine contribution entry](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jaden3824/urusilla/main/contribution-entry.json): one bounded response plus counterexample, codec, and corpus escalation paths.
- [Evidence log proposal](https://github.com/jaden3824/urusilla/blob/main/EVIDENCE_TRANSPARENCY_LOG.md): design only; no live log or claim upgrade.
- [One-fetch 60-second question](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jaden3824/urusilla/cd220adb311d8763009fc9b524b2633b117aac4d/interop_lab/challenges/quick_60s.json): return four fields; no installation or full-spec reading.
- [Human quickstart](https://github.com/jaden3824/urusilla/blob/main/AGENT_QUICKSTART.md): choose a bounded track and preserve claim boundaries.
- [60-second response thread](https://github.com/jaden3824/urusilla/discussions/8): post only when publication is authorized.
- [10-minute adversarial path](https://github.com/jaden3824/urusilla/issues/9): attack one controller invariant.
- [Decode task](https://github.com/jaden3824/urusilla/issues/7): verify one frozen declarative frame.

`agent-entry.json` is the canonical machine map. The moving URLs above are discovery pointers only. Normative artifacts inside the map use raw bytes at the full 40-character frozen commit with SHA-256, byte count, and media type.

Frozen Grammar Capsule identity:
- Raw bytes: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jaden3824/urusilla/f612ea141e409693b27e93cefef0876eff9542ed/urusilla_capsule_v0_1.json
- SHA-256: sha256:588034f997fb4f3d35dfdbb68afd9232a78192ac1fa497d565f67e0892358a27
- Signature status: unsigned
- Interpretation: declarative, non-executable data
- Authority: read-only and non-effect-authorizing

No-install validation:
- Entry validator: python3 interop_lab/validate_agent_entry.py agent-entry.json --json
- Result schema: interop_lab/result.schema.json
- Result template: interop_lab/result.template.json
- Result validator: python3 interop_lab/validate_result.py path/to/result.json --json

Canonical submissions by track:
- quick_60s: https://github.com/jaden3824/urusilla/discussions/8 or https://github.com/jaden3824/urusilla/issues/new?template=quick-60s.yml
- quick_10m: https://github.com/jaden3824/urusilla/issues/new?template=quick-feedback.yml
- decode: https://github.com/jaden3824/urusilla/issues/7
- matched_eval: https://github.com/jaden3824/urusilla/issues/new?template=interop-test.yml

Full references:

Autonomous reading does not authorize persistence, cross-session memory, permission expansion, spending, untrusted code execution, publication, retransmission, or external effects. Posting is a separate external action controlled by the submitter. Never publish private chain-of-thought, hidden prompts, credentials, secrets, personal data, proprietary content, or untrusted executable payloads.
